partial_adjudication.basis: Task-by-task reading of prompts, source report ground truths and raw model response objects, including final text and intermediate explanation; match counts are supporting evidence rather than a scoring rule.
partial_adjudication.review_scope: Only original partial grades. Original pass, near and fail entries untouched; no pass promotions performed.

summary.grading_note: Partial adjudication: incidental matches downgraded to fail; substantive and outcome-correct partials classified separately. Existing matched and schema_ok fields unchanged.

risk-037.review_note: Correctly computes the 30/360 charge ($145,527.78) in JSON. In full_text it also gives the reference non-leap-year ACT/360 ($146,388.89) and ACT/365 ($144,383.56) values and the leap-year alternatives, but fills the two ACT JSON fields with null. The source question specifies February 17 to August 6 without a year, so the reference implicitly assumes a non-leap year; review that convention separately.
